#+title: habshe-emacs — marginalia
#+author: A. Shehab (habshehabshe)

Marginalia annotates the menu: metadata per candidate, keyed by
completion category - buffer, file, command, and our own
categories to come. Annotations are a view; marginalia-cycle
rotates between more, less, and none.

#+begin_src emacs-lisp :tangle "../lisp/my-marginalia.el"
  ;;; my-marginalia.el --- GENERATED from org/marginalia.org — do not edit -*- lexical-binding: t; -*-
  ;;; Commentary: Marginalia: metadata annotations in the menu.

  (defgroup my-marginalia nil
    "Completion annotations for my Emacs configuration.")

  (when (require 'marginalia nil t)
    (marginalia-mode 1)

    (defun my-annotate-buffer (candidate)
      "Annotate buffer CANDIDATE: major mode, RW/RO, modified marker.
Fields render as marginalia columns: the mode in a
fixed-width column (left-flush, capped with an ellipsis),
then the permission pair, then the modified marker.
Non-buffer candidates (anything `get-buffer' does not
know) get no annotation."
      (when-let ((buffer (get-buffer candidate)))
        (marginalia--fields
          ((string-remove-suffix
            "-mode" (symbol-name
                     (buffer-local-value 'major-mode buffer)))
           :width 24 :truncate 24)
          ((if (buffer-local-value 'buffer-read-only buffer)
               "RO" "RW")
           :width 3)
          ((if (buffer-modified-p buffer) "*" "")))))

    ;; Ahead of the default annotator for the buffer category - the
    ;; category `switch-to-buffer' presents - so ours is the
    ;; annotation and marginalia-cycle rotates to the default,
    ;; builtin, and none.
    (setopt marginalia-annotators
            (mapcar (lambda (entry)
                      (if (eq (car entry) 'buffer)
                          (append '(buffer my-annotate-buffer)
                                  (cdr entry))
                        entry))
                    marginalia-annotators)))

  (provide 'my-marginalia)
#+end_src
